description: This PHP source file defines the ProviderAPI class, which implements REST API endpoints for managing OpenID providers within an HRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting OpenID provider records, along with validation rules and transaction management. The class interacts with a data access object to persist provider details and leverages traits for encryption, ORM, and social media authentication services.

classes.name: ProviderAPI
classes.description: Class providing REST API endpoints for CRUD operations on OpenID providers, including validation, transaction management, and interaction with data access objects.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all OpenID providers with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new OpenID provider, including saving provider info and extra details within a transaction.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves general provider information from request parameters into an OpenIdProvider entity.

methods.name: saveProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Saves or updates additional provider details, including client ID and secret, with optional encryption.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing providers.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the provider name, ensuring uniqueness and length constraints.

methods.name: getOpenIdProviderCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns an option object that ignores providers with inactive status for uniqueness validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of multiple providers by IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single provider by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single provider.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing provider's general info and extra details within a transaction.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a provider.
